B=\begin{bmatrix}2 & -3 & 4 \\ -5 & 1 & 7 \\ 3 & 8 & -2\end{bmatrix}.
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the following row operations on $B?$

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+{R}_{3} \\ {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+2{R}_{3}\end{aligned}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let's list the required operations:

- The operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+{R}_{3}$ means that we need to add $1$ times the third row to the second row.

- The operation ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+2{R}_{3}$ means that we need to add $2$ times the third row to the first row.

Applying the operations, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}B & =\begin{bmatrix}2 & -3 & 4 \\ -5 & 1 & 7 \\ 3 & 8 & -2\end{bmatrix}\quad {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+{R}_{3} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}2 & -3 & 4 \\ -5+(1)(3) & 1+(1)(8) & 7+(1)(-2) \\ 3 & 8 & -2\end{bmatrix} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}2 & -3 & 4 \\ -2 & 9 & 5 \\ 3 & 8 & -2\end{bmatrix}\quad {R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+2{R}_{3} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}2+(2)(3) & -3+(2)(8) & 4+(2)(-2) \\ -2 & 9 & 5 \\ 3 & 8 & -2\end{bmatrix} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}8 & 13 & 0 \\ -2 & 9 & 5 \\ 3 & 8 & -2\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$
